analysis.reason: RSI는 과매도 구간을 탈출했으나 50 이상으로 안착하지 못함. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 여전히 음수 구간. 5일 저가 대비 현재가 상승으로 Higher Low 패턴 가능성. 거래량은 증가했으나 추세 전환을 확신하기에는 지표들이 중립 구간에 머물러 관망.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold but has not yet settled above 50. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains in negative territory. Higher Low pattern potential forming with price rising from 5-day low. Volume increased, but indicators remain neutral, warranting a wait-and-see approach for trend confirmation.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($32.95) vs SMA5/20/50($31.68/$36.35/$38.90): Above short-term trend, below mid-term trend.
· Position vs SMA100/200($42.31/$42.32): Below long-term trend, in weak territory.
· 52-week position (14.8%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (32.6→41.2) + Exiting oversold territory + Confirming upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-1.2062→-0.3576) + Diagnosing improvement + Potential for trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band $36.35) + Interpreting band width at 56.88% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($31.81) + Based on pivot and moving averages.
· Swing Resistance ($34.18) + Expecting short-term upward momentum upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Forming Higher Low) + Interpreting as a recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.26x) + Increased confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Entry contingent on reclaiming support and breaking resistance.
